title: Treaty of Ahmet Pasha
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Treaty of Ahmet Pasha", at revision 1378177102, opens: "The Treaty of Ahmet Pasha was a treaty signed on 10 January 1732 between the Ottoman Empire and Safavid Iran." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q7836956, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "treaty between the Ottoman Empire and Safavid Persia". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
